title: Worked Examples: Variables on Both Sides & Word Problems
objectives: Solve equations containing fractional denominators using cross multiplication
Model word problems (ages, consecutive numbers) into algebraic equations

blocks.heading: Equations Reducible to Linear Form
blocks.content:
When an equation is in the form (ax + b) / (cx + d) = p / q:
1. Apply cross-multiplication: q * (ax + b) = p * (cx + d).
2. Expand both sides and group terms.
3. Note: The denominator cx + d cannot equal 0 (domain restriction).

steps: Step 3: Transpose 3x to LHS and -25 to RHS: 5x - 3x = -9 + 25.

workedExamples.prompt: Word Problem: The perimeter of a rectangle is 13 cm and its width is 2(3/4) cm = 11/4 cm. Find its length.
steps: Step 1: Let length be L. Perimeter formula: P = 2(L + W).

takeaways: Cross-multiplication converts fractional rational equations into simple linear equations.
x = 0 is a completely valid and normal solution!
